title: Landing Page
content: Create complete landing page structure. Hero section: full viewport height, headline (text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold), subheadline, dual CTA buttons, hero image. Trust bar: logos of customers/press mentions. Features section: 3-4 feature cards in grid with icons, titles, descriptions. Testimonials: carousel or grid of customer quotes. Pricing: 3 tier cards. variants.advanced: Create complete landing page structure with all essential sections. Hero section: min-h-screen or h-[90vh], flex items-center. Content: headline (text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl font-bold leading-tight), subheadline (text-xl text-gray-600 max-w-2xl), dual CTA buttons (primary filled, secondary outline), hero image or illustration (positioned right or below on mobile). Background: gradient, pattern, or image with overlay. Trust bar: logos of customers/press mentions in grayscale (filter grayscale opacity-60), flex justify-center gap-8 md:gap-12, "Trusted by" label. Features section: py-20 bg-gray-50. Section heading centered. Grid of 3-4 feature cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8). Each card: icon in colored circle, title (text-xl font-semibold), description (text-gray-600). How it works: numbered steps (1, 2, 3) with icons, titles, explanations, connected by lines or arrows. Benefits: alternating left/right image+text sections (flex-row-reverse for alternate). Testimonials: carousel or grid of customer quotes with photos, names, titles, company logos, star ratings. Pricing section: 3 tier cards (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) with monthly/annual toggle, features list with check/x icons, highlighted "Popular" tier, CTA per tier. FAQ: accordion style with ChevronDown icon, common questions. Final CTA: full-width colored banner (bg-gradient-to-r), compelling headline, single prominent button. Footer: multi-column links (Product, Company, Resources, Legal), social icons, newsletter signup input, copyright. Navigation: sticky header with logo, nav links, CTA button, mobile hamburger menu. Smooth scroll: scroll-smooth on html, anchor links to sections. Mobile-responsive: stack layouts, adjust typography sizes, collapsible nav. Animation: sections fade-in on scroll using IntersectionObserver.
